description: The viewpoint is from the cobbled Piazza del Quirinale at midday, taking in the long ochre facade of the presidential palace. The palace front runs from the left across the frame to the clock tower at the right, with the stone fountain basin sitting in the right foreground and umbrella pines closing the far right. The modelled 23 September 2026, 11:30 sun is bright overhead, the pale stucco glowing warm against a clear blue sky.
